# Pinned ReShade starter sources

These test fixtures are the original bytes of Curves, MagicHDR and Technicolor2 and all their includes. They are used through the real download verifier without network access. The tests ensure the installed sources resolve every include, retain author notices, and modify only include names. They are not automatically installed or enabled.

Sources and Git blob identifiers are recorded in sources.json. MagicHDR and FXShaders headers are pinned to luluco250/FXShaders commit 76365e35c48e30170985ca371e67d8daf8eb9a98. Curves and Technicolor2 are pinned to CeeJayDK/SweetFX commit 93ddf39b357f5da534ed6d34ba4ec8cc7dcfa361. ReShade.fxh is pinned to crosire/reshade-shaders commit fd0022170615ce0d8162d219bff07232fa6dd84f and retains its CC0 notice.
